doc.title: Bill Mays interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 5, 2025

title: His father wanted him to be a minister
summary: His father hoped he would be a minister, and later told him he had become one through his music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did you have to sell your parents on this career path?

Well I tried. My father wanted me to be a minister. And I wanted to be a musician. And it was very meaningful that years and years later my dad went to a concert in Italy where I was playing with Gerry and at the end of the concert he said, “I always wanted you to be a minister and you became one in your music and how you touch people.” And that was a wonderful moment.
